title: Estimation of Crop Water and Irrigation Requirement for Major Cereal Crops and Vegetables Using FAO CROPWAT 8.0 Model in the Hill Region of Nepal
venue: Research report, Nepal Agrotech Solution Pvt. Ltd.
abstract: Estimates the crop water requirement (CWR) and irrigation requirement (IR) of paddy, maize, wheat, potato and cauliflower in Nepal's hill region using the CROPWAT 8.0 model.

title: Optimizing Solar PV Deployment in Nepalese Universities: Techno-economic and Environmental Comparison of Fixed and Seasonal Tilt Systems
venue: B.E. undergraduate research, Purwanchal Engineering Campus, IOE
abstract: Shows that institutional rooftop PV can cost-effectively move universities toward energy independence, cutting reliance on diesel generators during outages and reducing emissions, with scalable insights for institutions in developing countries.
